bugClass.title: Unbounded note output exhausts agent context
bugClass.cause: Agent-facing CLI output or launch-brief generation includes every item note without a count, size, or recency bound, so session context grows with the full note history.
bugClass.criteria: Classify when an agent-facing command or launch-brief path serializes or formats item notes without limiting count or output size. Either CLI output that includes all notes or launch briefs that embed all notes qualifies independently. Exclude bounded summaries and paths that do not place notes in agent session context.

candidates.evidence: Lines 30–36 define the agent-facing `tracker_show` tool; after a user or agent invokes it for one item, it returns `item.notes.join('\n')` with no visible count or size bound. The excerpt establishes the unbounded output mechanism, but no runtime context exhaustion or incident.

Lines 79–82 cap `item.notes` at 32,000 characters in the brief’s Task section. The same brief also calls `trackerBriefNotes(item, recovery)`, whose limits are not shown, so the excerpt does not establish whether another note path is unbounded.

Lines 65–71 append `item.notes` and all output from `formatNativeTrackerNotes(item)` without a visible count or size bound. This is a native tracker inspection formatter, but the excerpt does not establish whether its output reaches an agent session or launch brief, so the class trigger is incomplete.

Lines 54–57 retrieve the full `notes_log` for `projectDetail`, with no visible bound in this excerpt. The excerpt does not show whether or how these notes are serialized into agent session context, so the required agent-facing trigger is unestablished.

Lines 20–33 map every `notes_log` entry into `WatchdogItem.notes` without a visible count or size bound. The excerpt does not establish that this watchdog state is placed in agent session context or a launch brief, nor show its output limit.

At lines 74–82, `put` maps every `row.notes` entry to serialized values and inserts them into the replica database without a visible bound. The excerpt establishes storage of all notes, but not that these values are emitted by an agent-facing CLI or launch brief into session context.

`runTaskOrchestration.ts:33–36` reads a brief file and passes it to `supervise`, but the excerpt shows no note serialization or launch-brief generation. Whether the brief embeds unbounded item notes is not established.
